title: DAFormer: Improving Network Architectures and Training Strategies for Domain-Adaptive Semantic Segmentation (RCS + ImageNet feature distance)
mechanism: Rare-class sampling of source images plus an L2 distance that keeps bottleneck features close to the frozen ImageNet encoder (thing-class pixels), with lr warmup; protects pretrained features during adaptation.
evidence: GTA to Cityscapes: self-training 58.2, +FD 61.7, +RCS 64.0, both 66.2 mIoU; with no target data (pure DG) RCS+FD add +5.1 mIoU (supp. Table S3); also helps DeepLabV2.
adaptation: FD as a soft alternative to PF: L2 between layer4 features of the training ResNet-34 and a frozen ImageNet ResNet-34 (weight 0.005 to 0.05, all pixels or crack/inactive/defect pixels). This targets the found erasure of layer3/4 that PF fixes (E1 inactive 0.05 to 0.24). RCS: sample training cells by rarity of inactive, splice, gridline and material.
min_experiment: Arms house+FD, house+FD+RCS, PF+RCS vs house and PF, 5 seeds. Metrics: E1 inactive IoU, E1 crack relF1@2, test inactive IoU, splice/gridline IoU. Kill: house+FD not within 0.03 of PF on E1 inactive and no other gain; RCS killed if inactive and splice gain < +0.03.
prior_overlap: Partial: PF already tests encoder preservation by freezing and low lr; the FD loss and rare-class sampling were never run. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: The feature distance directly counters our finding that the house fine-tune erases ResNet layer3/layer4. Add an L2 loss to frozen ImageNet R34 layer4 on crack, inactive and splice pixels (weight 0.005 to 0.05), as an alternative or complement to PF. RCS: sample training cells by rarity of crack, inactive, splice and gridline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm FD-RCS vs house PF, 5 seeds. Metrics: E1 inactive IoU, clean-49 crack IoU, mIoU_rob. Kill if no metric beats PF beyond the seed noise.

alt_notes.adaptation: Rare class sampling over cells with crack, inactive (42 cells), splice, gridline. Feature-distance regulariser as a soft form of PF encoder preservation. MiT-B5 at 512 px with 1-ch replicated to 3 as a benchmark entry.
alt_notes.min_experiment: (a) house + RCS vs house; kill if test and E1 inactive IoU gains < +0.02. (b) house + FD vs PF; kill if not better than PF on E1. 3 seeds each.
